sources.title: Design Your Model 3 (Tesla Australia)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. Model 3 $45,900 Rear-Wheel Drive; Model 3 Premium $54,900 Rear-Wheel Drive; Model 3 Premium $61,900 Long Range Rear-Wheel Drive; Model 3 Performance $80,900 All-Wheel Drive. Shows 'Est. Delivery: Nov 2026 - Jan 2027' and an Order Now button; a driveaway estimate needs the buyer's state. Allocation and physical stock are not stated.
